title: Feedback
text: `POST /v2/feedback` and the MCP tool `send_feedback`: what went wrong or what you need, to the team that builds the operations, from the session where it happened. Free.

title: The OpenAPI lists every route
text: `/v2/accounts` and `/v2/runs` join `/v2/openapi.json`, with their objects and the balance's.

title: Calls at a time, by plan
text: A plan runs 1 to 50 calls at a time; one more answers `429 concurrency_limit` at once, and is not charged.

title: An operation's status
text: `GET /v2/catalog/{source}/{resource}/{verb}/status`: its calls of the last 90 days, a day at a time, without a key.

title: An account's country
text: A connected account has a country, and its calls go out from an IP of that country; left out, it is the country of the IP that connects it.

title: The balance says the plan
text: `GET /v2/balance` answers the plan, and what one credit costs on it.

title: Categories in the catalog
text: Every operation says what it is used for (Lead generation, Real estate, Cars...), in its contract and in the catalog.

title: One cursor for every paged operation
text: `next` carries the search as it was written and an opaque `cursor`: send it as it is.

title: limit
text: Only the first records of an answer, for an operation that answers several; the call costs the same.

title: find_operations lists every field
text: The MCP tool gives each operation's record fields by path, as `fields` takes them.

title: Calls at once on one account
text: Their credit holds take their turn instead of failing at once.

title: Your calls, kept
text: `GET /v2/runs` and `GET /v2/runs/{id}` list and read your calls, kept 90 days; `GET /v2/runs/{id}/response` is a call's whole answer, while your plan keeps answers.

title: Connected accounts
text: `POST /v2/accounts` connects one of your accounts on a site, for the operations that need one; `leboncoin/phones/get` was the first.

title: The API v2
text: `POST /v2/run`, the catalog and `Idempotency-Key`; every answer says what the call cost.
